title: Hedging + discourse markers
recall: Fikrni yumshatishning 5 ta usuli va 5 ta bog'lovchini (however, whereas…) ayt.
formula: hedging: It seems / appears that, tend to, likely, arguably, to some extent, I'd say, might
qarama-qarshilik: however, whereas, on the other hand, having said that, even so
sabab/natija/qo'shimcha: as a result, therefore, in fact, moreover, in other words

pairs.b: This seems to be the best solution.
He tends to be a bit lazy.

items.uz: Bu eng yaxshi yechim bo'lsa kerak.
en: This seems to be the best solution.
It seems that this is the best solution.
This appears to be the best solution.

items.uz: Odamlar ko'pincha kechqurun ko'proq ovqat yeydi.
en: People tend to eat more in the evening.
I'd say that's partly true.
I think it's true to some extent.
I'd say it's partly true.
It's expensive. However, it's good quality.
It's expensive. Having said that, it's high quality.
It's expensive; however, it's good quality.

items.uz: Men choyni yaxshi ko'raman, akam esa kofeni.
en: I like tea, whereas my brother likes coffee.
I love tea, whereas my brother loves coffee.
As a result, we missed the train.

items.uz: Aslida, u menga hech narsa demagan.
en: In fact, he didn't tell me anything.
Actually, he didn't tell me anything.
In fact, he told me nothing.

items.uz: Bir tomondan, shahar qulay; boshqa tomondan, shovqinli.
en: On the one hand, the city is convenient; on the other hand, it's noisy.
On the one hand the city is convenient, on the other hand it is noisy.
This is arguably the most important problem.
This is probably the most important issue.
This is likely the most important problem.

items.uz: Boshqacha qilib aytganda, bizda pul yo'q.
en: In other words, we don't have any money.
In other words, we have no money.
Moreover, he is very experienced.
What's more, he's very experienced.
Furthermore, he is very experienced.
Prices are likely to rise.
Prices might go up.
Prices may rise.

items.uz: Shunday bo'lsa ham, men urinib ko'raman.
en: Even so, I'll try.
Even so, I'm going to try.
It seems that he's upset.
He seems to be upset.
She seems upset.
That's why I left my job.
Therefore, I left my job.
To some extent, it's your fault.
It's your fault to some extent.

items.uz: Masalan, siz har kuni 10 daqiqa o'qishingiz mumkin.
en: For example, you could read for 10 minutes every day.
For instance, you can read for ten minutes a day.
Overall, the project was successful.
All in all, the project was a success.

items.uz: Tan olish kerakki, men adashgan edim.
en: Admittedly, I was wrong.
I have to admit that I was wrong.
Despite the rain, we went for a walk.
In spite of the rain, we went for a walk.

speak: Bahsli mavzu (masalan, ijtimoiy tarmoqlar): 2 daqiqa, kamida 5 ta hedging va 5 ta bog'lovchi.
Ishxonangiz haqida: ijobiy va salbiy tomonlar (on the one hand…).
Kimnidir yumshoq tanqid qiling: tends to, a bit, might want to.
